date_check: Every story above happened, or was first reported, on Thursday 26 November 2026. Deliberately left out: the UN court ruling on Myanmar (22 Nov) - GTA 6's launch (19 Nov) - the Trump-Xi-Putin meeting in Shenzhen (20 Nov) - Nepal's prime minister in Delhi (22-23 Nov).

numbers.label: tankers hit mines in Hormuz on Wednesday
ships attacked in the Strait in October
Russian refining output cut since late October
Dow closes above 50,000 for the first time
Russian soldiers killed, Moscow's own figures
KOSPI's fall as Asian markets slide

sources_note: Verified against Reuters, IRNA, Xinhua, WHO and Financial Times reporting on 26 November 2026.

stories.deck: IRGC Navy says the ships used unauthorised routes and caught fire; a third tanker burned on Sunday and an LNG carrier exploded on Wednesday evening.
stories.headline: Two tankers hit mines in Hormuz and explode

stories.deck: Drones hit Syzran and Kuibyshev in Samara hours after Putin called retaliation "inevitable"; Savasleyka airbase hit, 3 MiG-31s and 2 Su-34s claimed damaged.
stories.headline: Kyiv sets two Rosneft refineries ablaze

stories.deck: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali becomes the first foreign astronaut to visit China's space station.
stories.headline: Shenzhou-24 docks at Tiangong with Pakistan's first astronaut

stories.deck: Colonel Mohammad Abuelouf is killed with his wife and two children; Hamas internal security head Naim Abu Nahal also killed as the ceasefire strains.
stories.headline: Israel kills Hamas internal security chief

stories.deck: The Houthi attack sets fires at Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery; the Saudi-led coalition hits Hodeidah port and the Houthis threaten Jeddah.
stories.headline: Houthis hit Ras Tanura refinery; Saudis strike Hodeidah

stories.deck: A jury finds the Chinese tech giant guilty of bank fraud, wire fraud, sanctions violations and trade-secret theft after a years-long US case.
stories.headline: Huawei convicted on 10 of 12 counts in Brooklyn

stories.deck: KOSPI falls 6.16%, Nikkei 2.78% and Taiex about 5%; the Dow ends at 50,018.70, its first close above 50,000, as the Nasdaq drops 1.5%.
stories.headline: Asia slides; the Dow closes above 50,000

stories.deck: The Antalya summit ends without a fossil-fuel phase-out deal after Saudi Arabia and producers block it; Pope Leo XIV voices concern.
stories.headline: COP31 fails as oil states block fossil phase-out

stories.deck: Two Libyan naval officers were killed in the Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian vessel.
stories.headline: Libya vows retaliation after drone strike on Russian warship at Benghazi

stories.deck: The pact bars any foreign military base on Solomon Islands soil.
stories.headline: Solomons sign treaty with Australia banning foreign military bases

stories.deck: The vote rolls back parts of the bloc's nature-protection rules.
stories.headline: EU Parliament votes 367-268 to loosen nature law

stories.deck: The ECJ sets a concrete timeline to end caged farming.
stories.headline: EU top court: livestock cages must be banned

stories.deck: The Commission proposes 50 billion euros for quantum and a 50 billion euro Sovereign Tech Equity Fund.
stories.headline: EU unveils 50bn euro quantum plan and tech fund

stories.deck: The Section 301 plan targets the EU and thirteen other trading partners.
stories.headline: US proposes 15% tariff on the EU and 13 partners

stories.deck: The strike hits a civilian area as the war grinds on.
stories.headline: RSF drone attack kills 19 civilians

stories.deck: Rescuers search the flooded mine in West Java.
stories.headline: Bogor gold mine floods: 6 dead, about 20 trapped

stories.deck: Twenty people held for 17 hours are freed unharmed.
stories.headline: Police storm Cartagena supermarket, free 20 hostages

stories.deck: Revenue rises 103% and AI server sales hit 22 billion dollars, up 291%.
stories.headline: Dell posts record quarter: revenue 54.9bn dollars

stories.deck: Investigators point to faulty welds and subsidence.
stories.headline: Train crash blamed on bad welding and sinking ground

stories.deck: The WHO updates the toll in the ongoing outbreak.
stories.headline: Ebola death toll reaches 5,775

stories.deck: The nation also celebrates Constitution Day, 77 years after the constitution was adopted.
stories.headline: India marks 18 years since the 26/11 Mumbai attacks

stories.deck: The new seats start from 2027 across the institutes.
stories.headline: IITs to add 6,000 seats in robotics, AI and space

stories.deck: The Nepal package follows talks with Prime Minister Balendra Shah.
stories.headline: Modi meets Merz; India offers Nepal 15,000 crore rupees

stories.deck: Entry-level garment workers get a 36% pay rise.
stories.headline: Bangladesh raises garment minimum wage 36%

stories.deck: The tremor strikes near the Chinese border.
stories.headline: 5.6-magnitude quake hits Koshi Province

stories.deck: Pyongyang tells Switzerland to close its newly opened diplomatic office.
stories.headline: North Korea orders Switzerland to shut its office

stories.deck: The former prime minister asks to come home next month.
stories.headline: Sheikh Hasina seeks return to Bangladesh on 16 December

stories.deck: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi sets the fastest List A double century, against the UAE.
stories.headline: Sooryavanshi, 15, smashes 204 off 53 balls

stories.deck: India's champion opens his World Chess Championship defence.
stories.headline: Gukesh faces Sindarov for the world title in Geneva

stories.deck: A record field signs up for next year's auction.
stories.headline: 1,220 players register for the IPL 2027 auction

stories.deck: The Walmart-owned group's CEO leaves in December.
stories.headline: Flipkart chief Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down

stories.deck: The attorney general sidesteps questions on the Nvidia investigation.
stories.headline: US attorney general dodges Nvidia questions

stories.deck: Proposals to trade business deals for a Ukraine settlement are dropped.
stories.headline: US shelves plan to use Russia business deals to end war

stories.deck: Russia's Duma passes the 2027-29 budget with defence up 27% to 17.1 trillion roubles; Norway pledges 7bn dollars for Ukraine in 2027.
stories.headline: Moscow's own toll: about 490,334 soldiers killed

stories.deck: The Zaporizhzhia plant loses external power; a Russian strike on a flat kills 2 and wounds 40-plus, and a Russian drone enters Polish airspace.
stories.headline: Nuclear plant loses outside power; flat hit, 2 dead

stories.deck: Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes slash mosquito-borne viral infections in Brazil.
stories.headline: Mosquito release cuts viral infections 68%
